data.define: An idiom for very heavy rain.

misuse.text: Don't look for real animals when it's 'raining cats and dogs'.
misuse.why: It's an idiom for heavy rain.

data.l1_hook: 外を見て！傘を持って！ \"raining cats and dogs\" です。
data.l1_ex: 今、\"raining cats and dogs\" です！

native.hook: 「raining cats and dogs」ってどういう意味？
native.tip: “raining cats and dogs” = 土砂降り. 例文: “It's raining cats and dogs!”
